title: encode_ffmpeg
description: Encodes raw RGB24, grayscale or YUV420P frames to H.264 or H.265 with FFmpeg and forwards the compressed packets downstream.

codec.description: Output codec; "h265" or "hevc" selects H.265, any other value selects H.264.

hwaccel.description: Hardware encoder family; unknown values fall back to the software encoder.

encoder.description: Explicit FFmpeg encoder name that overrides codec and hwaccel; empty means resolve from them.

bitrate.description: Target bitrate in bits per second.

fps.description: Encoder frame rate; 0 uses a microsecond time base instead.

preset.description: Encoder preset option; empty skips setting it.

tune.description: Encoder tune option; empty skips setting it.

frame_width.description: Width of incoming frames; frames pass through unencoded while this is 0.

frame_height.description: Height of incoming frames; frames pass through unencoded while this is 0.

stream_filter.description: Only this stream id is encoded and other streams pass through; -1 encodes all streams.
